delta_acceptance.method: measured against the running stack before and after each change: the quarantine stream for the OKX fence, publish-minus-close on md.canonical.v2 for bar delivery, the consumer group for backlog, and a benchmark on the spool's own volume for the write ceiling

bar_delivery.definition: publish time minus bar close time on md.canonical.v2, final bars only. The consumer contract max_freshness_ms=180000 is a tolerance, and the canonical envelope timestamps a bar by its open time, so neither says anything about delivery

binance.why: a closed Binance 1m kline was still changing 5.04s (BTCUSDT) and 3.96s (ETHUSDT) after its close boundary

venue_boundaries_retested_2026_09_17.conclusion: venue-side on this host, not configuration: the ingestor binds <symbol>@markPrice@1s with a logical target and the core expects the same channel at the same catalog revision
